name: Paper Discussion (论文讨论)
description: Discussion of a research paper: contributions, critiques, and ideas for our own work.

sections.title: Paper and Context
sections.instruction: Identify the paper(s) discussed (title, authors, venue if mentioned) and why they were discussed.

sections.title: Key Contributions
sections.instruction: List the main ideas, techniques, and results of the paper as explained in the discussion.

sections.title: Critiques and Open Questions
sections.instruction: List limitations, flawed assumptions, missing evaluations, and unresolved questions raised.

sections.title: Ideas for Our Work
sections.instruction: List ideas, extensions, or connections to our own research that came up.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List follow-up tasks (reading, experiments, writing) with owners and deadlines.
